purpose: Audit runtime evidence readiness after completion of the revised PEP 12-volume unit sequence and full diagnostic evidence classification.

layers.notes: England statutory placements and Common Core codes resolve from primary standards. China resolves to the 2022 national learning stage/domain hierarchy with verified printed primary-domain ranges.

layers.coverage: All four primary domains have printed page ranges and stage/domain hierarchy
layers.notes: Use printed domain range + learning stage + subsection/item. Exact single-page bullet locators remain unrendered for the 40 MB official PDF and must not be invented.
Grade/semester/unit sequence is verified from a publisher-authored all-volume table and registered in the runtime.

layers.coverage: 10/12 volumes have some current/revised below-unit detail; active volumes vary in page-level precision
layers.notes: Show only the subsection/lesson/page detail actually supported. Later-semester designed books are not treated as missing current classroom artifacts.

layers.coverage: 12/12 volume slots have a final artifact evidence state
layers.notes: 3 ISBNs verified; one candidate kept internal/unverified; other active ISBNs explicitly not publicly recovered; later-semester volume artifact state classified by rollout applicability. Legacy ISBN substitution is forbidden.

layers.coverage: Series rollout separated from documented locality/term use
layers.notes: Actual use requires locality/publisher/term context. This is not a global missing field.
Stored bilingual copy is language-independent by concept ID and preserves jurisdiction/evidence status.
When system-specific current use is not verified, describe a representation as an instructional option rather than a national-frequency claim.
Use guidance/research for rationale; teaching moves are selected by concept fit, not national stereotype.

layers.coverage: 121/121 concepts have a diagnostic route; 80/80 canonical misconception records classified
layers.notes: Every misconception has an explicit evidence class. Probe-only records remain possible misunderstandings, not research-established prevalence claims.
Task source IDs support rationale, not national-use claims.

layers.coverage: Core comparison copy and classroom tasks fully stored in zh/en
layers.notes: Evidence IDs/statuses remain unchanged across language switch.

may_show_without_special_warning: China learning-stage/domain placement with printed range and hierarchy
Stored bilingual comparison explanations that preserve source status
Pedagogical options supported by guidance/research without national-frequency claims
Diagnostics phrased according to their canonical evidence class
may_show_with_qualification: PEP subsection/lesson detail from secondary current materials
Artifact metadata classified as not publicly recovered
Series-designed later-semester PEP volumes whose actual-use rollout is not yet verified
China exact bullet locator using printed range + hierarchy rather than a fabricated single page
must_not_show_as_fact: Invented China exact bullet page numbers
Legacy PEP sequence or ISBN labelled current
Nationwide/local PEP use inferred from the series sequence
National method-frequency claims inferred from curriculum/guidance
Stable misconception diagnosis from one pupil response
